items.statement: The independently validated LS spectrum supports metal-centered spectral overlap with the fluorescence-relevant window and a possible nonradiative-transfer explanation within the model boundary.
items.expected: The conclusion follows from submitted calculations and evidence, distinguishes supported assignment from causal proof, and does not claim a computed solid-state transfer rate.

items.statement: The conclusion is limited by the truncated local model and vertical TD-DFT approximation.
items.expected: Those limitations and unresolved method sensitivity are stated.
